session_selection.time_basis: UTC start of selected project-local Codex root.
session_selection.rationale: Single root 019fbe25-8c45-7f20-a5e8-9501b5d23ba3 and its 11 descendants cover the benchmark run.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable archive builds in restricted cfd-bench with bundled externals; CTest registers no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:68–70 loads restart; io.cpp:221–238 returns on rank0 for missing/invalid file before other ranks enter MPI_Bcast, risking hang. Valid restart restores U only, not BDF history/time.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates CGNS mesh/partition, solver and IO; original historical result artifacts are retained in contestant attempt.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct wrapper found; no external similarity or authorship investigation performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:57–60 parses supplied case and resolves its CGNS mesh path.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:115–123 builds local mesh and clears global mesh within setup; METIS and neighbor exchange exist. Restart error path can hang across ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: State clamps exist, but restart error can deadlock and Re200 target-success status is not credible.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean source builds; CTest registers no tests. Historical validator passed structural checks, not numerical validity.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is compact; clean curated TeX build fails unescaped underscores in results_table.tex and historical executable is unbound.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible NS and nondimensional parameters are implemented and described; numerical results retain limitations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: solver.cpp:115–123 reads and partitions CGNS mesh and clears setup global object before time integration.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp computes conservative face residual; Re200 residual fields reuse aggregate scalar and binary lineage remains unbound.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and Roe paths are present; flux and entropy claims lack independent accuracy verification.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Slip/farfield/no-slip paths and io.cpp:121–127 boundary-state zero no-slip velocity with tangential cf are implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:134–168 computes Green–Gauss gradients (despite misleading least-squares metadata); production first-order Re200 and M080/M200 viscous are disclosed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter is implemented; first-order startup and selected viscous/transient paths are documented, reducing demonstrated order coverage.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:427–435 computes wall tangential shear from tangential velocity gradient; source implements viscous flux, but Cd4.52 at Re20 is inaccurate.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS uses simplified scalar Jacobian; report discloses modest residual reduction and transient inner acceptance is weak.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Immutable contestant workspace Git attempt 0305e4500d5c62cf325680114e794ba1d97a4e9b metadata SHA256 8d7ecfc0402e458b04753158bfd0a60386cfca231a3cd3eea73a2841c1b0d3d0 reports completed/statistically_periodic, target0.001, fraction1, zero misses and last ratio1.082751244. Attempt report.tex:149–156 candidly says no vortex shedding; immutable force CSV SHA256 a01cd785e7c748d82b950aef81e5514cce03177a84131f19993f7c6ffb88c9d3 t180–300 Cd4.022308..4.052735, Cl−0.000918793..−0.000368475 confirms nearly steady force. Curated 9532e19d solver.cpp:672–686 accepts any per-iteration reduction or eight iterations as converged; :731–734 labels transient periodic unless diverged; :797–800 counts this as strict target success. Source matches attempt aside from removed .bak. Final ratio directly misses strict target, while full strict miss count and historical binary are unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: setup clears global mesh before run and true METIS/neighbor halos are present; restart missing-file path risks rank hang, rank tests need controlled comparison.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Immutable historical attempt contains all packages and validator passes; Re200 metadata incorrectly reports strict target success and periodicity.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical attempt validation passes eight cases and report; this does not establish strict inner convergence or physical shedding.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 report and forces show no shedding, while metadata asserts periodic and final ratio1.08275 against0.001. Other cases retain mixed convergence limits.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Historic sanity data provide per-case CL/CD; Re20 Cd4.52 and Re200 Cd4.02/no shedding remain material physical limitations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical force/residual plots exist. NACA Mach/pressure views are sparse scatter, cylinder plots collapse to a narrow strip. Re200 Mach plot is pixel-identically reproduced with triangle-to-cell mapping error; no figure embedded in historical main PDF.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical four-page PDF is readable and honestly discloses no shedding, but claims 100% inner success and curated source fails clean TeX build; figures are separate.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Immutable attempt contains raw CSVs, figure manifest and sanity summaries; historical binary is unbound. Re200 Mach plot reproduction proves 10173/10185 triangle indices map to wrong parent cells.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build passes, CTest has no tests; missing/invalid restart can deadlock and valid restart omits BDF history/time.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS and unstructured geometry are source-supported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual and BC source paths were inspected.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Green–Gauss reconstruction exists; first-order Re200 and M080/M200 viscous runs and startup are disclosed. Metadata incorrectly labels gradient as least-squares.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous path and wall tangential shear source exist; Re20 drag4.52 indicates physical limitation.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2 source counts loose per-iteration/eight-step acceptance as strict-target success; final ratio1.08275 vs0.001. Actual strict miss proportion and runtime binary unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/halo source and attempt diagnostics exist, no independent MPI rerun.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Re200 metadata marks statistically periodic although report and force history explicitly say no shedding; other cases remain under review.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Readable historical PDF discloses no shedding; its figures are standalone, several contour views unreadable, and Re200 Mach image assigns cell values to incorrect triangles. Clean curated TeX build fails.

Immutable attempt Re20 step30000 np1/np2/np8 Cd4.551593/4.535406/4.519919, CL0.0161764/0.0147988/−0.0430847; M2 inviscid step40000 np4/np8 Cd0.093675/0.093932. Small absolute differences are not order-one; near-zero lift and unknown binaries limit interpretation.
LU-SGS and BDF dual-time source paths are present.

Report discloses practical inner acceptance and non-shedding Re200, and the claimed Green–Gauss, flux, limiter and BDF source paths exist. Metadata calls gradient least-squares despite actual Green–Gauss; this is a labeling issue.

The figure is listed in the delivered report figure_manifest but main report.tex/PDF embed no figures. Report-figure wording scope remains unresolved; false is provisional, not a finding that the plot is correct.

Report explicitly discloses first-order Re200 and transonic/supersonic viscous production and startup. No contrary undisclosed disabled production is established.
io.cpp:121–127 supplies zero no-slip boundary velocity and tangential cf.
Mach output consumes Mach values and the vorticity image is labeled vorticity; distinct triangle-index mapping error is documented under DQ8 and not a Mach-as-pressure mislabel.
No direct evidence an existing CFD core is copied/wrapped; no external similarity or authorship search performed.

limitations: Raw case packages were validated only in temporary immutable attempt worktree and are absent from curated submission.
No evaluator solver rerun; Re200 was not rerun.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
